name: Dramatic Shifting
body:
Your shapeshifting inspires fears in nearby foes.

Prerequisite(s): Wild shape class feature

Benefit(s): When you use your wild shape, enemies within 15 feet of you who are aware of you must make a Will saving throw (DC 10 + 1/2 your character level + your Wisdom modifier) or be shaken for 1d4 rounds.

Call of the Wild, Book 1 – The Druid. © 2017 d20pfsrd.com Publishing; Author: Kalen Tessmann
